subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-reproducible, but existing linked branches are stale, conflicting, abandoned, or broader than this issue, and choosing adoption, replacement, or closure requires maintainer ownership judgment.

options.title: Replace With Focused Fix
options.body: Sponsor a narrow replacement that writes routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

options.title: Adopt Existing Candidate
options.body: Pick one linked PR, rebase it, address the known wrong-route risks, and make it the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close Remaining Scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is not supported.

recommendation.title: Replace With Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow replacement that writes routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped message-tool fix, authored adjacent outbound threading follow-ups, and recently touched the affected session/channel paths.
